message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Five high-confidence vulnerability groups affecting monitored products were newly published or updated in the 24-hour window from 2026-08-25 05:10 IST to 2026-08-26 05:10 IST. The most urgent items are the critical Veeam ONE issue and Apache Tomcat's important-rated authentication, access-control, and denial-of-service flaws.

**Finding 1: Veeam ONE 13 vulnerability set**

- Product: Veeam ONE 13
- Issues: CVE-2026-65641, CVE-2026-58075, CVE-2026-58074, CVE-2026-64631, CVE-2026-64632, CVE-2026-64634, CVE-2026-64630
- Severity: Critical (9.3), five High (8.4-8.7), and Medium (5.3), as rated by Veeam
- Summary: The newly released updates address unauthenticated SMB-authentication coercion and arbitrary-file-read paths, plus authenticated code execution, SQL injection, NTLM credential capture, local privilege escalation, and report-data exposure.
- Relevance: Veeam is explicitly monitored. The advisories affect Veeam ONE version 13 builds; deployment/version confirmation is required.
- Source: [Veeam KB4905](https://www.veeam.com/kb4905) and [Veeam ONE 13 release information](https://www.veeam.com/kb4762)

**Finding 2: Apache Tomcat 9.0.121 vulnerability set**

- Product: Apache Tomcat
- Issues: CVE-2026-73180, CVE-2026-68763, CVE-2026-68569, CVE-2026-68525, CVE-2026-66422, CVE-2026-65927, CVE-2026-65905, CVE-2026-65637, CVE-2026-65183, CVE-2026-65182
- Severity: Four Important, one Moderate, and five Low, as rated by Apache
- Summary: Apache disclosed flaws involving HTTP/2 resource exhaustion, fail-open principal lookup, security-constraint and RewriteValve access-control bypasses, SNI validation bypass, WebSocket/session handling, DIGEST replay, role references, and Unix-domain-socket permissions.
- Relevance: Apache Tomcat is explicitly monitored. Tomcat 9 findings affect various releases through 9.0.120; some issues also affect Tomcat 10.1 and 11.0 families.
- Source: [Apache Tomcat 9 security page](https://tomcat.apache.org/security-9.html)

**Finding 3: OpenSSL coordinated security release**

- Product: OpenSSL
- Issues: CVE-2026-75803, CVE-2026-14457, CVE-2026-18798, CVE-2026-54874, CVE-2026-63072, CVE-2026-63073, CVE-2026-63074, CVE-2026-63075, CVE-2026-63076
- Severity: Three Moderate and six Low, as rated by OpenSSL
- Summary: The disclosures cover an AEAD authentication-tag bypass, CMS heap overflow, and multiple QUIC, DTLS, and CMP denial-of-service conditions. Affected branches include OpenSSL 3.0, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6, and 4.0, with narrower applicability for individual CVEs.
- Relevance: OpenSSL is explicitly monitored and is also shipped by Ubuntu.
- Source: [OpenSSL vulnerability list](https://openssl-library.org/news/vulnerabilities/) and [Ubuntu USN-8678-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8678-1)

**Finding 4: Veeam Backup & Replication credential logging**

- Product: Veeam Backup & Replication 13
- Issue: CVE-2026-58070
- Severity: Medium (6.8), as rated by Veeam
- Summary: Guest OS credentials used for application-aware processing may be written in cleartext to logs on the guest machine.
- Relevance: Veeam is explicitly monitored; affected builds are 13.0.2.29 and earlier version 13 builds.
- Source: [Veeam KB4902](https://www.veeam.com/kb4902)

**Finding 5: Ubuntu 22.04 Azure and NVIDIA Tegra IGX kernel updates**

- Product: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS kernel packages
- Issues: CVE-2026-64531, CVE-2026-53246, CVE-2026-53224
- Severity: Not clearly stated in the Ubuntu notice
- Summary: Canonical published fixes for Linux kernel vulnerabilities in the Open vSwitch and SCTP subsystems for Azure and NVIDIA Tegra IGX kernel variants.
- Relevance: Ubuntu is explicitly monitored, but the advisory applies only to the listed Ubuntu 22.04 kernel variants; confirm those packages are deployed.
- Source: [Ubuntu USN-8658-3](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8658-3)

**Possible matches needing review**

- Adobe Content Credentials SDK advisory APSB26-110 was published on August 25 and covers multiple denial-of-service and arbitrary-file-read CVEs, including CVE-2026-71442, CVE-2026-71443, CVE-2026-71360, CVE-2026-76189, and CVE-2026-76198. Adobe Creative Cloud is monitored, but the available evidence does not confirm that this separately named SDK is deployed with the monitored Adobe products. Source: [Adobe APSB26-110](https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/content-authenticity-sdk/apsb26-110.html)
- Saudi NCA issued a High-severity SonicWall alert on August 25, but the public alert does not identify affected product names or CVEs. The monitored list contains SonicWall SMA 8200V, so product applicability could not be confirmed. Source: [Saudi NCA alert 2026-7781](https://nca.gov.sa/en/cert/7905/)

The dedicated MongoDB sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and MongoDB-owned advisories whose titles might omit the vendor name. No credible MongoDB-related vulnerability was newly published or substantively updated in the window.

Immediate review is recommended for Veeam ONE 13 deployments and Tomcat installations through the affected version ranges. OpenSSL and Ubuntu package exposure should be checked next. Third-party WordPress plugin findings were excluded because none matched the named monitored plugins (Yoast SEO and Advanced Custom Fields).
